Priya: quick sync — GigaHW interested in bundling our LangChain + LlamaIndex gateway adapter into their marketplace SKU and co-announcing. Need owners + a lean plan.
Omar: eng can do a v0 adapter (ingest -> vector query -> embeddings -> stream) in ~9 working days. request: sample KB + API contract.
Priya: DevRel will own the notebook + 60s demo GIF. need streaming + embeddings to showcase live summarization.
Leah: marketplace/legal note — publisher contract, security attestation, and perf matrix required. manifest + assets due 10 business days before publish.
InfraBot: Scheduled perf run on Giga A10x2 (JOB-4021). ask: 3 workloads (short/med/long). ETA 3 business days for baseline.
Omar: sample demo curl for README:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/adapters/gigahw/run -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" -d '{"flow":"kb-retrieval->rerank->summarize","source":"lindex://kb-sample","max_tokens":120,"stream":true}'
```
Omar: adapter config I'll push: `name: rwd-gigahw-lc`, `batch_size:8`, `stream:true`, `quant_profile:q4_0`. smoke tests: basic query, rerank stability, streaming.
Priya: proposed timeline: PR in 9 working days, QA+smoke 3 days, perf 3 days, assets+manifest 4 days, legal 5 days -> external announce target ~4w, internal demo ~3w.
Leah: Owners: Adapter = @Omar, Notebook/GIF = @Priya, Perf/infra = @InfraBot, Assets = @DesignBot, Marketplace/legal = @Leah.
DesignBot: :eyes: will queue GIF + screenshots once notebook link posted. need high-res logos.
Priya: I'll draft announcement copy and share for legal review.
Omar: pushing PR by EOD and tagging QA + infra.
InfraBot: JOB-4021 running. will post results in thread.
Leah: Opened legal intake (TKT-8109). scheduling weekly 15-min sync Fridays until publish. please react :white_check_mark: when your item is green.
